claim: Treating moonshine coefficients as a count of light four-dimensional species does not determine an induced Einstein action and produces an immediate curvature-coupling, species-scale and vacuum-energy problem in the simplest scalar toy.
status: conditional one-loop heat-kernel stress test; the mapping from CFT degeneracies to 4D fields is deliberately not admitted

toy.fields: N real scalar fields in four Euclidean dimensions
toy.schemeBoundary: Both power divergences depend on regulator and renormalization conditions; they are diagnostic scalings, not predictions.

exactForks.minimalScalar: xi=0 gives M_Pl,ind^2 = N Lambda^2/(96 pi^2)
exactForks.conformalScalar: xi=1/6 gives no quadratically induced Einstein term in this coefficient
exactForks.loopFactorGap: The cutoff needed to make the one-loop minimal-scalar Einstein coefficient order one is sqrt(96 pi^2) about 30.78 times the naive species scale M_Pl/sqrt(N).

ruledOut: Inferring a four-dimensional Newton constant from the coefficient 196884 alone.
Treating CFT states at one conformal grade as independent light particle species without a field/operator map.
Claiming that a large degeneracy solves the vacuum-energy hierarchy in the minimal scalar induced-gravity toy.
reopenConditions: Specify the 4D fields, spins, statistics, masses and nonminimal curvature couplings selected by the lattice/CFT construction.
Provide a covariant regulator/renormalization prescription and bare gravitational terms.
Demonstrate a controlled low-energy spectrum and cosmological-term relation.
